title: Webb County Approves Casa Blanca Rental Fees, Food Truck Rules
excerpt: Webb County Commissioners Court unanimously approved a rental fee schedule for Casa Blanca Lake facilities, with weekday rentals $1,200 to $1,500 and weekend rentals $2,000.
content:
Webb County Commissioners Court unanimously approved a rental fee schedule and related plans for Casa Blanca Lake facilities, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The facilities covered include the community center and warehouse, event venues, the pavilion and the palapa, the report said. Precinct 1 Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez led the discussion, according to the report.

Rental rates are $1,200 to $1,500 on weekdays and $2,000 on weekends, plus a $200 deposit and $50 for each extra hour, according to the Laredo Morning Times. Food trucks will pay a $250 flat fee for events and mobile vendors will pay $50, the report said. Concession and event rates are $50 per hour for for-profit vendors and $25 per hour for nonprofit vendors, according to the report.

The plan also allows food truck vendors at the lake facilities, and the report said restrooms will be closed at sunset. The article noted some uncertainty in the wording of facility hours, so visitors planning an event should confirm hours with the county before booking.

County Judge Tano E. Tijerina has until November 16 to form a committee — including at least two commissioners, the county administrator and the road and bridge director — to set rules for future events, according to the Laredo Morning Times.
